verification.precondition: The strict SourceSnapshot contract, canonical digest authorities, and pure Survey intake builder exist as package-owned files.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The same ordered logical names and UTF-8 bytes produce one byte-identical immutable SourceSnapshot with derived ordinals, exact bytes, evidence digests, aggregate digest, and name.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: ordered UTF-8 intake deterministically builds one immutable SourceSnapshot
verification.forbiddenMutation: The builder must not retain mutable caller bytes, reorder entries, accept a caller-selected identity, read a filesystem path, or create runtime/profile state.

behavior: ordered UTF-8 intake deterministically builds one immutable SourceSnapshot
